# Pertemuan 2
```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
data(iris)
head(iris)
```

```{r}
iris_long <- iris %>%
  gather(key = "Measurement", value = "Value", -Species)

head(iris_long)
```

```{r}
iris_separated <- iris_long %>%
  separate(Measurement, into = c("Part", "Dimension"), sep = "\\.")

head(iris_separated)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
data(PlantGrowth)
df = PlantGrowth
glimpse(df)
pull(df, weight)
slice_max(df, weight, n = 5)
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)
crossing(df)
```

```{r}
plot(0, 0, type='n', ylim=c(-30,30), xlim=c(-25,25),
     main='Membuat Logo',
     asp=1)
r=25
x=0 #pusat
y=0 #pusat
theta=seq(0,2*pi,length=1000)
a=x+r*cos(theta)
b=y+r*sin(theta)
polygon(a,b,col="skyblue",border="skyblue")

r=20
x=0 #pusat
y=0 #pusat
theta=seq(0,2*pi,length=1000)
a=x+r*cos(theta)
b=y+r*sin(theta)
polygon(a,b,col="white",border="white")

r=15
x=0 #pusat
y=0 #pusat
theta=seq(0,2*pi,length=1000)
a=x+r*cos(theta)
b=y+r*sin(theta)
polygon(a,b,col="lightgreen",border="lightgreen")

x=c(-3,-3,3,3)
y=c(-15,15,15,-15)
polygon(x,y,col="white", border="white")

x=c(-20,0,20)
y=c(25,5 ,25)
polygon(x,y,col="white", border="white")

r=7
x=0 #pusat
y=20 #pusat
theta=seq(0,2*pi,length=1000)
a=x+r*cos(theta)
b=y+r*sin(theta)
polygon(a,b,col="red",border="red")
```

```{r}
n <- 4
for (i in 1:n) {
  spasi <- strrep(" ", n - i)
  bintang <- strrep("*", 2*i - 1)
  cat(spasi, bintang, "\n", sep = "")
}
```
